actions.label: 󰤨  Wi-Fi
actions.command: sh -c '[ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ] && nmcli radio wifi on || nmcli radio wifi off'
actions.update-command: sh -c '[ "$(nmcli radio wifi)" = enabled ] && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: 󰂯  Bluetooth
actions.command: sh -c '[ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ] && { rfkill unblock bluetooth; bluetoothctl power on; } || bluetoothctl power off'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'bluetoothctl show 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Powered: yes" && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: 󰒃  VPN
actions.command: sh -c '[ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ] && pkexec veloguard-vpn connect || pkexec veloguard-vpn disconnect; pkill -RTMIN+7 waybar'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'veloguard-vpn active >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: 󰀝  Airplane
actions.command: sh -c '[ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ] && rfkill block all || rfkill unblock all'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'rfkill list | grep -q "Soft blocked: no" && echo false || echo true'

actions.label: 󰖔  Night
actions.command: sh -c '[ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ] && { pkill hyprsunset; setsid -f hyprsunset -t 4000 >/dev/null 2>&1; } || pkill hyprsunset'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'pgrep -x hyprsunset >/dev/null && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: 󰄀  Shot
actions.command: sh -c 'swaync-client -cp; sleep 0.4; grim -g "$(slurp)" - | wl-copy && notify-send -u low "Screenshot copied"'
